name: Jordon Gorham
strengths: Gorham tracks deep balls over the shoulder, then hits the brakes on underthrows and works back through the DB for the contested catch.
Gorham high-points red-zone fades — climbs and plucks at the apex over smaller corners instead of letting it settle into his chest.
Gorham’s long stride eats cushions on vertical stems (go/post) and he finishes catches away from his body down the boundary.
weaknesses: Gorham still needs mass on the 6-4 / 180 frame to handle SEC press and win through contact at the line — most tape is vs off coverage.
comparison: Gorham comps to Justyn Ross — 6-4 boundary length WR who wins with catch radius, high-point fades, and deep tracking as the frame fills.
projection: Gorham projects as Year-1 red-zone / vertical package snaps, Year 2 compete for outside reps, Year 3 SEC starter upside at X if the mass lands.
schemeFit: Gorham fits as a boundary X who stresses defenses vertically and in the red zone while the frame fills toward every-down outside snaps.
insiderNotes: Gorham is a 6-4 IMG boundary WR who wins with length, over-the-shoulder tracking, and red-zone high-points. Lean 180 frame still filling. Florida offered with Marcus Davis on the file; UF sits ~21% RPM with two UOVs (latest Mar 12) while South Carolina leads the board.
staffNotes: Vault film desk re-watched Hudl 2026-08-30 (full highlight package). filmWatched:true. Comp size-matched 6-4 (Justyn Ross) — not a Florida-alum default; Sutton replaced as over-band for Natl #357.
recruitingStory: Jordon Gorham is a 4★ WR · listed 6-4 / 180 · IMG Academy (Saint Stephen, SC) · open-board Florida target with Marcus Davis offer.
angle: Lead with 6-4 IMG length + high-point; Florida boundary WR chase.
